definition: (1) To transfer from disk to magnetic tape. (2) To save or put away data where direct access is no longer needed.
A collection or set of data files; records.
A subdivision of a data record; for example, author and contract number are data items or fields of a memo record.
Storage area on disk to place and keep a collection of data records for later access.
Special language used to give instructions to the computer.
Process by which the computer performs program instructions in order to permit smooth operation - for example; opening, closing, and deleting files.
To place data into a file.
User process of being identified to the computer for further operation.
A special note displayed on the terminal to the user by the computer program.
A type of task for a specific job.
A special listing of data provided to the user by the computer for later reference or use.
A subdivision of a file consisting of a set of data items from a document.
To find or locate a specific set of data; records.
A group or set of fixed computer instructions designed to perform special tasks.
Process by which the computer transfers a special output file to the printer for a printout.
A part or subdivision of a file.
A device with typewriter keys used to communicate with the computer.
Any person initiating interaction with the computer.
